cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.
